import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from sklearn.linear_model import LinearRegression
from scipy.stats import t

# Prepare the data for regression
X = df_merged[['iv_offshoring_1']].values.reshape(-1, 1)
y_share = df_merged['share_immi_imputed'].values
y_empl = df_merged['empl_immi_imputed'].values

# Fit the models
model_share = LinearRegression().fit(X, y_share)
model_empl = LinearRegression().fit(X, y_empl)

# Calculate coefficients
coefficients_share = model_share.coef_[0]
coefficients_empl = model_empl.coef_[0]

# Calculate standard errors
# Assuming homoscedasticity and using the formula for standard error
n = len(X)
k = 1  # Number of predictors
se_share = np.sqrt((sum((y_share - model_share.predict(X))**2) / (n - k - 1)) / (np.sum((X - np.mean(X))**2)))
se_empl = np.sqrt((sum((y_empl - model_empl.predict(X))**2) / (n - k - 1)) / (np.sum((X - np.mean(X))**2)))

# Calculate t-statistics
t_stat_share = coefficients_share / se_share
t_stat_empl = coefficients_empl / se_empl

# Calculate p-values
p_value_share = 2 * t.sf(abs(t_stat_share), df=n - k - 1)
p_value_empl = 2 * t.sf(abs(t_stat_empl), df=n - k - 1)

coefficients_share, p_value_share, coefficients_empl, p_value_empl
